title: 울릉도ㆍ흑산도 등 국토외곽 먼섬 지원 특별법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 울릉도ㆍ흑산도 등 국토외곽 먼섬 지원 특별법 시행령
full_text: Article 6 (Special Support through Local Allocation Tax) Where a local government requests special financial support for a project implemented pursuant to the comprehensive development plan and annual implementation plans on grounds of special fiscal demand arising from a local issue, apart from the recipients of allocations under Articles 6, 9, 9-3, and 9-4 of the Local Allocation Tax Act, the Minister of the Interior and Safety may, pursuant to Article 7 (2) of the Act, review the request and allocate special local allocation tax within the available operating resources of the local allocation tax.
